about_the_game:
LOCK & LOAD... AND LAUNCH YOURSELF!

Are you ready to experience pure, unfiltered frustration? In this rage-inducing physics platformer, you don’t play as a hero—you are the gun! There’s no walking, no jumping—just shooting yourself through the air with pure firepower.

HOW FAR CAN YOU CLIMB?

Every shot propels you forward (or backward, if you're not careful). Master precise aiming, momentum control, and recoil physics to navigate various obstacles, platforms, and heartbreaking falls.

FEATURES:

Brutal but fair gameplay – Precision matters. One wrong shot, and you’re back to square one.
You ARE the gun – No legs, no arms—just bullets and physics!
Momentum-based movement – Bounce, roll, and blast your way to victory.
A soundtrack that mocks you – Soothing when you're winning, soul-crushing when you fall.
Failure is the only teacher – Every mistake is a lesson learned.
